note: The demo GIFs for the hand recorder's v2 script: one recording per part, in this order. Motions are what the maintainer performs on camera; the plan is the Claude Doc ee05ba65 (Demo recordings, 2026-10-12).

motions: Both hands about 40 cm out, still
Palms toward you, then backs toward you
Fingers spread, then a fist, then point
About 1 s for each shape

parts.title: Wrist roll
motions: One hand low and relaxed, other fingers loosely curled
2 light taps palm down
2 taps edge-on, 2 palm up, 2 palm toward your face

parts.title: Through the zones
motions: Keep tapping while you move: centre at chest height
Far out to your side, then crossed past the middle
Close to your face, then at arm's length
Quick taps, a double tap, one slow press

parts.title: Both hands
motions: Both hands tapping
Then one hand over the other, still tapping

parts.title: Wrist roll and zones
motions: Thumb to the middle finger's pad, index half-curled
2 taps palm down, edge-on, palm up, toward your face
Then a few taps out to the side and close to your face

parts.title: Firm presses and a head turn
motions: 3 slow, firm presses
Keep tapping and turn your head until the hand reaches the edge of the view
Then turn the other way

parts.title: Fingers
motions: Stop 1 cm short of a tap
Rub the thumb along the side of the index
Ring finger to thumb
Let a loosely curled hand rest

parts.title: Fists
motions: Close a fist slowly, open it
Close it fast, open it
Once at chest height, once low

parts.title: One hand
motions: Pinch and hold 3 s
Drag up, down, left, right
Roll the wrist while holding
Loosen the other fingers without letting go

parts.title: Two hands
motions: One hand holds a pinch, the other taps
Hands apart, then close, then crossed
Thumb on the index and middle tips
Move up and down slowly, then fast
Let the ring finger join once

parts.title: Fingertips drop
motions: Arms forward, palms up, fingers flat: hands close (elbows tucked)
Fingertips drop toward the floor and back: 1 slow, 2 fast
Same with forearms half out, then arms straight
One drop low at the waist, one at eye height

parts.title: Fingertips rise
motions: Palms up at the same three distances
Fingertips curl up toward you and back: 1 slow, 2 fast each

parts.title: Pinch while bent
motions: Palm up, hold a pinch
Drop the fingertips and raise them, still pinching
Flip palm up and down with the wrist bent
Lazy susan stroke each way, with the return stroke
A wave
5 s of talking with your hands

parts.title: Grab that
motions: Open palm at a far target
Close to a fist and pull back

parts.title: Push, flick, a real object
motions: Push away, then flick away
Reach for a cup or your phone
Two fists: hold, pull apart, push together
Fists with the palms in, down, then up

parts.title: Out and back
motions: Right hand open: slide out past the right edge until gone, wait 1 s, back
Same up past your face
Left hand pinching: out past the left edge, then down past your lap

parts.title: Crossing
motions: Both hands cross fully to the opposite sides
Hold a moment, come back
Type a few words, use the mouse, pick up the phone
One tap, then back to the keys
Pick up the controllers, set them down
A tap in between
